You're trying to install react-leaflet, but vite@7.0.0 requires a newer Node.js version:

✅ Solution:

You have Node.js v20.12.2, but vite@7.0.0 needs at least v20.19.0 or v22.12.0.

👉 Option 1: Update Node.js to v20.19.0 or higher

If you're okay upgrading Node.js (recommended), here's how:

If you're using nvm:

bash
nvm install 20.19.0
nvm use 20.19.0

Then run again:

bash

If you prefer not to update Node right now, you could downgrade Vite:

bash

Then run:

⚠️ Important:

Also delete the existing package-lock.json file if you're using Yarn, so it doesn't cause conflicts:

bash
rm package-lock.json

And make sure you're using a yarn.lock file instead.

Here is the fully fixed and working EventDetailPage.jsx with the Leaflet map properly integrated using event.latitude and event.longitude.

Make sure to install dependencies and import the Leaflet CSS as mentioned earlier.

✅ EventDetailPage.jsx (Full Working Version with Map)

jsx
import { useParams, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { loadStripe } from '@stripe/stripe-js'
import { MapContainer, TileLayer, Marker, Popup } from 'react-leaflet'
import L from 'leaflet'
import AuthModal from '../components/AuthModal'
import './EventDetailPage.css'
import defaultEvent from '../assets/defaultEvent.jpg'
import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css'

// Fix missing default marker icons in Leaflet
delete L.Icon.Default.prototype._getIconUrl
L.Icon.Default.mergeOptions({
  iconRetinaUrl: require('leaflet/dist/images/marker-icon-2x.png'),
  iconUrl: require('leaflet/dist/images/marker-icon.png'),
  shadowUrl: require('leaflet/dist/images/marker-shadow.png'),
})

const stripePromise = loadStripe('pk_test_51RcVeBBU1Fa59mBKHvngFVDwq8gBiZ863TKO6okEHBj28VjLiYAUQ5OhDs0k1WEyfqXRmtziurmLYBqlQfyOOl6C007EKiWppc')

export default function EventDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams()
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams()
  const refCode = searchParams.get('ref')

  const [event, setEvent] = useState(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState(false)
  const [showAuth, setShowAuth] = useState(false)
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [emailAsked, setEmailAsked] = useState(false)
  const [selectedTierId, setSelectedTierId] = useState(null)
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1)

  const token = localStorage.getItem('token')
  const isLoggedIn = token && token.length > 0

  function isValidUrl(url) {
    return url && typeof url === 'string' && url.trim() !== '' && url !== 'null'
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return
    if (!token || token.length < 10) {
      setShowAuth(true)
      return
    }

    fetch(`http://localhost:8080/events/${id}`, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      },
    })
      .then(res => {
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to fetch event: ${res.status}`)
        return res.json()
      })
      .then(data => {
        if (!data || !data.title) throw new Error('Invalid event data')
        setEvent(data)
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('❌ Event load error:', err)
        setError(true)
      })
  }, [id, token])

  const handleBuy = async () => {
    if (!isLoggedIn) return setShowAuth(true)
    if (!emailAsked && !email) return setEmailAsked(true)
    if (!selectedTierId) return alert('Please select a ticket tier')

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`http://localhost:8080/api/tickets/checkout`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          eventId: parseInt(id),
          ticketTierId: selectedTierId,
          quantity,
          email,
          ref: refCode,
        }),
      })

      const data = await res.json()
      if (data.free === 'true') {
        window.location.href = `/success?eventId=${id}`
        return
      }

      if (data.clientSecret) {
        const stripe = await stripePromise
        const result = await stripe.confirmCardPayment(data.clientSecret)
        if (result.error) return alert(result.error.message)

        await fetch(`http://localhost:8080/api/tickets/confirm?paymentIntentId=${result.paymentIntent.id}`, {
          method: 'POST',
        })
        window.location.href = `/success?eventId=${id}`
      } else {
        alert(data.error || 'Unexpected server response')
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('❌ Checkout failed:', err)
      alert('Checkout error. Try again.')
    }
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="event-error">Failed to load event. Please try again later.</div>
  }

  if (!event && !showAuth) {
    return <div className="event-loading">Loading event...</div>
  }

  return (
    <div className="event-fullscreen">
      <div className="event-top-section">
        <img
          src={isValidUrl(event?.imageUrl) ? event.imageUrl : defaultEvent}
          alt="Event"
          className="event-hero-image"
          onError={(e) => {
            e.target.onerror = null
            e.target.src = defaultEvent
          }}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="event-content">
        <h1 className="event-title">{event.title}</h1>
        <p className="event-date">📅 {formatDate(event.dateTime)}</p>
        <p className="event-location">📍 {event.location}</p>

        <div className="event-actions">
          <button className="btn-primary" onClick={handleBuy}>+ Register</button>
          <button className="btn-secondary">Contact</button>
          <button className="btn-secondary">Share</button>
        </div>

        <div className="event-about">
          <h3>About</h3>
          <p>{event.description || 'No description provided.'}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="event-map">
          <h3>Location</h3>
          {event.latitude && event.longitude ? (
            <div style={{ height: '300px', borderRadius: '16px', overflow: 'hidden', marginTop: '12px' }}>
              <MapContainer
                center={[event.latitude, event.longitude]}
                zoom={15}
                scrollWheelZoom={false}
                style={{ height: '100%', width: '100%' }}
              >
                <TileLayer
                  attribution='&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors'
                  url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
                />
                <Marker position={[event.latitude, event.longitude]}>
                  <Popup>
                    {event.title} <br /> {event.address}
                  </Popup>
                </Marker>
              </MapContainer>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="map-placeholder">Map not available.</div>
          )}
        </div>

        {emailAsked && (
          <div className="event-email-input">
            <input
              type="email"
              placeholder="Enter your email"
              value={email}
              onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {showAuth && (
        <AuthModal
          onClose={() => {
            setShowAuth(false)
            window.location.reload()
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function formatDate(isoString) {
  const date = new Date(isoString)
  return date.toLocaleString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'long',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: '2-digit',
  })
}

Here’s what you need to add and tweak to make sure the map looks good inside your app:

css
.event-map {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  text-align: left;
}

.event-map h3 {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.leaflet-container {
  width: 100%;
  height: 300px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  z-index: 0;
}

.map-placeholder {
  background-color: #ccc;
  height: 300px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #555;
  font-weight: bold;
}

This ensures:

  • the map fills its container,

  • it has proper rounded corners,

  • and it won’t break the layout even if latitude or longitude are missing.

✅ 3. Ensure Fullscreen View Holds the Content

If your page container uses #root { max-width: 1280px; ... }, and body is display: flex, make sure your layout inside EventDetailPage doesn't get cut off. You can set the map container inside a scrollable or responsive wrapper.

L.Icon.Default.mergeOptions({

css
body {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  background: black;
  color: white;
}

/* FULLSCREEN BACKGROUND */
.event-fullscreen {
  min-height: 100vh;
  width: 100vw;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #010314 0%, #050a30 100%);
  overflow-y: auto;
}

/* HERO IMAGE */
.event-top-section {
  width: 100%;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.event-hero-image {
  width: 100%;
  max-height: 480px;
  object-fit: cover;
  filter: brightness(0.85);
  border-bottom: 3px solid #00ff88;
}

/* MAIN CONTENT WRAPPER */
.event-content {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 48px 24px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}

/* TITLE + DATE + LOCATION */
.event-title {
  font-size: 40px;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  text-align: center;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, #00ff88, #00e0ff);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}

.event-date,
.event-location {
  font-size: 15px;
  color: #aaa;
  margin: 2px 0;
  text-align: center;
}

/* ACTION BUTTONS */
.event-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 24px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
}

.btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(to right, #00ff88, #00e0ff);
  color: #000;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 14px 26px;
  font-size: 16px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px #00ff88aa;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.btn-secondary {
  background-color: #1b1b1b;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 14px 22px;
  font-size: 16px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 1px solid #444;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.02);
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px #00ffcc;
}

.btn-secondary:hover {
  background-color: #2a2a2a;
  border-color: #666;
}

/* SECTION BLOCKS (ABOUT, MAP, TICKETS) */
.event-about,
.event-map,
.event-tickets {
  width: 100%;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 20px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  padding: 32px;
  margin-top: 32px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
}

.event-about h3,
.event-map h3,
.event-tickets h3 {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  color: #00ff88;
}

.event-about p {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #ddd;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* MAP SECTION */
.leaflet-container {
  width: 100%;
  height: 320px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.map-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 320px;
  background-color: #111;
  border-radius: 16px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #666;
  font-size: 15px;
}

/* TICKET TIERS */
.ticket-tier {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 16px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
  font-size: 15px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.ticket-tier.selected {
  color: #00ff88;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #00ff88;
}

.ticket-quantity {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  align-items: center;
}

.ticket-quantity input {
  width: 64px;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #555;
  background: #0d0d0d;
  color: white;
  text-align: center;
}

/* EMAIL INPUT */
.event-email-input input {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 16px;
  padding: 14px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #1b1b1b;
  border: 1px solid #333;
  color: white;
  font-size: 15px;
}

/* LOADING + ERROR */
.event-loading,
.event-error {
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 20px;
  color: #ccc;
}

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .event-title {
    font-size: 30px;
  }

  .event-about,
  .event-map,
  .event-tickets {
    padding: 24px;
    border-radius: 16px;
  }

  .btn-primary,
  .btn-secondary {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .event-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
  }
}

  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}

.event-date,
.event-location {
  font-size: 15px;
  color: #cccccc;
  margin: 4px 0;
  text-align: center;
}

/* ACTION BUTTONS */
.event-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 24px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
}

.btn-primary {
  background: #00E676;
  color: #000;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 14px 26px;
  font-size: 16px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px #00E676aa;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.btn-secondary {
  background-color: #121226;
  color: white;
  padding: 14px 24px;
  font-size: 16px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 1px solid #303050;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  transform: scale(1.03);
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px #00E676cc;
}

.btn-secondary:hover {
  background-color: #1c1c36;
  border-color: #444466;
}

/* SECTION CARDS */
.event-about,
.event-map,
.event-tickets {
  width: 100%;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  border-radius: 20px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  padding: 32px;
  margin-top: 32px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.event-about h3,
.event-map h3,
.event-tickets h3 {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #00E676;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.event-about p {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #dddddd;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* MAP */
.leaflet-container {
  width: 100%;
  height: 320px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.map-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 320px;
  background-color: #111;
  border-radius: 16px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #666;
  font-size: 15px;
}

/* TICKET TIERS */
.ticket-tier {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 16px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
  font-size: 15px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.ticket-tier.selected {
  color: #00E676;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #00E676;
}

/* QUANTITY INPUT */
.ticket-quantity {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  align-items: center;
}

.ticket-quantity input {
  width: 64px;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #555;
  background: #0d0d0d;
  color: white;
  text-align: center;
}

/* EMAIL INPUT */
.event-email-input input {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 16px;
  padding: 14px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #1c1c2c;
  border: 1px solid #444;
  color: white;
  font-size: 15px;
}

/* LOADING + ERROR */
.event-loading,
.event-error {
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 20px;
  color: #cccccc;
}

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .event-title {
    font-size: 30px;
  }

  .event-content {
    padding: 32px 16px;
  }

  .btn-primary,
  .btn-secondary {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .event-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .event-about,
  .event-map,
  .event-tickets {
    padding: 24px;
  }
}

import { useParams, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { loadStripe } from '@stripe/stripe-js'
import { MapContainer, TileLayer, Marker, Popup } from 'react-leaflet'
import L from 'leaflet'
import AuthModal from '../components/AuthModal'
import './EventDetailPage.css'
import defaultEvent from '../assets/defaultEvent.jpg'
import appstoreIcon from '../assets/appstore.png'
import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css'
import markerIcon2x from 'leaflet/dist/images/marker-icon-2x.png'
import markerIcon from 'leaflet/dist/images/marker-icon.png'
import markerShadow from 'leaflet/dist/images/marker-shadow.png'

// Fix missing default marker icons in Leaflet
delete L.Icon.Default.prototype._getIconUrl
L.Icon.Default.mergeOptions({
  iconRetinaUrl: markerIcon2x,
  iconUrl: markerIcon,
  shadowUrl: markerShadow,
})

const stripePromise = loadStripe('pk_test_51RcVeBBU1Fa59mBKHvngFVDwq8gBiZ863TKO6okEHBj28VjLiYAUQ5OhDs0k1WEyfqXRmtziurmLYBqlQfyOOl6C007EKiWppc')

export default function EventDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams()
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams()
  const refCode = searchParams.get('ref')

  const [event, setEvent] = useState(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState(false)
  const [showAuth, setShowAuth] = useState(false)
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [emailAsked, setEmailAsked] = useState(false)
  const [selectedTierId, setSelectedTierId] = useState(null)
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1)

  const token = localStorage.getItem('token')
  const isLoggedIn = token && token.length > 0

  function isValidUrl(url) {
    return url && typeof url === 'string' && url.trim() !== '' && url !== 'null'
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return
    if (!token || token.length < 10) {
      setShowAuth(true)
      return
    }

    fetch(`http://localhost:8080/events/${id}`, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      },
    })
      .then(res => {
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to fetch event: ${res.status}`)
        return res.json()
      })
      .then(data => {
        if (!data || !data.title) throw new Error('Invalid event data')
        setEvent(data)
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('❌ Event load error:', err)
        setError(true)
      })
  }, [id, token])

  const handleBuy = async () => {
    if (!isLoggedIn) return setShowAuth(true)
    if (!emailAsked && !email) return setEmailAsked(true)
    if (!selectedTierId) return alert('Please select a ticket tier')

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`http://localhost:8080/api/tickets/checkout`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          eventId: parseInt(id),
          ticketTierId: selectedTierId,
          quantity,
          email,
          ref: refCode,
        }),
      })

      const data = await res.json()
      if (data.free === 'true') {
        window.location.href = `/success?eventId=${id}`
        return
      }

      if (data.clientSecret) {
        const stripe = await stripePromise
        const result = await stripe.confirmCardPayment(data.clientSecret)
        if (result.error) return alert(result.error.message)

        await fetch(`http://localhost:8080/api/tickets/confirm?paymentIntentId=${result.paymentIntent.id}`, {
          method: 'POST',
        })
        window.location.href = `/success?eventId=${id}`
      } else {
        alert(data.error || 'Unexpected server response')
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('❌ Checkout failed:', err)
      alert('Checkout error. Try again.')
    }
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="event-error">Failed to load event. Please try again later.</div>
  }

  if (!event && !showAuth) {
    return <div className="event-loading">Loading event...</div>
  }

  return (
    <div className="event-fullscreen">
      {/* Floating App Store Icon */}
      <a
        href="https://apps.apple.com/app/idYOUR_APP_ID"
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener noreferrer"
        className="event-app-download"
      >
        <img src={appstoreIcon} alt="Download on App Store" />
      </a>

      <div className="event-top-section">
        <img
          src={isValidUrl(event?.imageUrl) ? event.imageUrl : defaultEvent}
          alt="Event"
          className="event-hero-image"
          onError={(e) => {
            e.target.onerror = null
            e.target.src = defaultEvent
          }}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="event-content">
        <h1 className="event-title">{event.title}</h1>
        <p className="event-date">📅 {formatDate(event.dateTime)}</p>
        <p className="event-location">📍 {event.location}</p>

        <div className="event-actions">
          <button className="btn-primary" onClick={handleBuy}>+ Register</button>
          <button className="btn-secondary">Contact</button>
          <button className="btn-secondary">Share</button>
        </div>

        <div className="event-about">
          <h3>About</h3>
          <p>{event.description || 'No description provided.'}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="event-map">
          <h3>Location</h3>
          {typeof event.latitude === 'number' && typeof event.longitude === 'number' ? (
            <div style={{ height: '300px', borderRadius: '16px', overflow: 'hidden', marginTop: '12px' }}>
              <MapContainer
                center={[event.latitude, event.longitude]}
                zoom={15}
                scrollWheelZoom={false}
                style={{ height: '100%', width: '100%' }}
              >
                <TileLayer
                  attribution='&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors'
                  url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
                />
                <Marker position={[event.latitude, event.longitude]}>
                  <Popup>
                    {event.title} <br /> {event.address}
                  </Popup>
                </Marker>
              </MapContainer>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="map-placeholder">Map not available.</div>
          )}
        </div>

        {emailAsked && (
          <div className="event-email-input">
            <input
              type="email"
              placeholder="Enter your email"
              value={email}
              onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {showAuth && (
        <AuthModal
          onClose={() => {
            setShowAuth(false)
            window.location.reload()
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function formatDate(isoString) {
  const date = new Date(isoString)
  return date.toLocaleString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'long',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: '2-digit',
  })
}

  • No height limits on body; all scrolling is on .event-fullscreen
